• Tarsus continues to advance one of the most compelling pipelines in eye care, with multiple upcoming clinical milestones. ◦ TP-04: The Phase 2 Kore trial for the potential treatment of ocular rosacea continues to progress, with topline data expected in the first half of 2027. ◦ TP-05: Completed enrollment in the Phase 2 Calliope trial for the potential prevention of Lyme disease.

Topline results are expected in the first half of 2027 and are anticipated to support a Phase 3-ready package. ◦ IRX-101: Plan to initiate the Phase 3 Comfort study evaluating an investigational ocular antiseptic for patients receiving intravitreal injections in the first half of 2027, with topline results expected in 2028. ◦ Gildeuretinol: Enrollment continues to progress in the global Phase 3 Northstar trial for the potential treatment of Stargardt disease, with topline results expected in 2029.
